manifest.displayName: iPhone Mirroring TikTok Seeding Video Discovery
manifest.author: GrassEye Builtins

taskTemplate.displayName: iPhone Mirroring TikTok Seeding Video Discovery
taskTemplate.description: Open iPhone Mirroring through Open Local Program, navigate the mirrored iPhone TikTok app through the visual chain, and collect governed seeding-video evidence.
taskTemplate.defaultHumanGoal: Use iPhone Mirroring to inspect TikTok video surfaces for visible product-seeding candidates without posting, liking, messaging, following, purchasing, or changing private data.

operationalMap.displayName: iPhone Mirroring TikTok Seeding Video Discovery
operationalMap.humanGoal: Open iPhone Mirroring, use visual targeting to open the TikTok app and video surface, sample visible frames, classify product-seeding signals, persist evidence, scroll safely, and review on ambiguity.

policy.safetyPolicy: Open only governed iPhone Mirroring through open-local-program. Internal TikTok app navigation must use screenshot, visual-target, geometry-guard, mouse-click or mouse-scroll, PAV, and forensics. No posting, liking, commenting, messaging, following, purchasing, or private data extraction.
policy.reviewPolicy: Low confidence, missing target, modal overlay, screen lock, target app unavailable, PAV failure, or geometry ambiguity must route to human review.
policy.exportPolicy: forensics evidence refs and structured summaries only
policy.debugPolicy: scenario may publish a Commander start-mission task only; no direct local app launch or direct desktop actions
